reason: The patch adds `try { MatcherAssert.assertThat(driver.findElement(By.xpath("//form[@id='webauth']")), nullValue()); fail(...); } catch (Exception nsee) {}` at PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest (patch lines 542-547 and 563-568). `findElement` never returns null, so `nullValue()` can never pass, and `catch (Exception)` would also swallow unrelated WebDriver failures. One correction: the assertion is not fully dead code — if the form exists it throws an AssertionError, which `catch (Exception)` does not catch, so the presence case is still detected.
